profile.name: Babalola Unique Samuel
bioParagraphs: I’m a brand and digital strategy lead with a passion for creating brand experiences that truly connect people and business. For over 8 years, I’ve worked across fintech, energy, logistics, and corporate brands in Africa and Europe, shaping stories, campaigns, and digital touchpoints that drive growth and engagement.

My work cuts across creative direction, brand strategy, content design, digital storytelling, influencer partnerships, and campaign management. I enjoy finding new ways to tell authentic stories, build communities, and push creative boundaries.
